text:
The evening shift brought up a concern about leash checks, and we welcome your letter. You said your companion animal was handled too abruptly, that the leash process felt confusing, and that the experience left you worried about the care shown by Aurelia Skyways staff.

We take that seriously. At the Companion Animal Travel Desk, our job is to keep travel calm, safe, and humane for animals and their people. Handlers are expected to use steady, gentle methods, not rushed ones, and the cabin team keeps watch during flight so concerns can be caught early. When a passenger raises a concern, supervisors listen, the details are reviewed, and any service change is recorded in the desk ledger so the next shift sees the full picture.

If the leash check felt rough or unclear, that is not the standard we want to set. The point of the check is safety, but safety should never come with a cold touch or a scattered explanation. We are looking into the handling notes, reinforcing the leash procedure, and reminding the team that clear communication matters just as much as control.

Your report helps us correct course, and we appreciate that. If you travel with us again, we want the process to feel calm, respectful, and predictable from curb to cabin. Thank you for speaking up and giving us the chance to improve.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
